title: Hong Kong National Security Police Arrest Boom News Founder Tang Ho-wing
detail: Hong Kong national security police arrested Tang Ho-wing, founder of independent outlet Boom News, in the latest press freedom crackdown under the National Security Law. The arrest marks another blow to independent journalism in Hong Kong following the closure of Apple Daily and Stand News under similar national security charges.

title: Xi Jinping Addresses Economy and Taiwan at National Day Reception
detail: Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the National Day reception marking the 77th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China, focusing on economic priorities and Taiwan policy heading into Q4 2026. The address signaled Beijing's continued emphasis on domestic economic stabilization amid trade tensions with the West while reaffirming its position on Taiwan reunification.
